sm_obligations: QK: SMs of quadrant q compute exactly the KV rows i with (i mod 512)//128 == q and write the raw FP32 score of every query head of that row into slice q at the address the map gives (KV rows striped to the quadrants in 128-row chunks; with 8 SMs/quadrant, 16 rows per SM per 512-row block)
PV: the same SMs read P of their own rows from slice q only (no cross-quarter read); GQA: one streamed V line x 4 local P values

PV reduction: per-SM FP32 partials over disjoint row sets must be summed to one PV vector and written so that PV word j lands in slice (j mod 512)//128 -> a 4-quadrant REDUCE-SCATTER (on-die COLL 2x2 ring or SM-side), fixed-slot; the FP32 summation order must equal the reference attention order (bit-exact) or the golden must be re-derived and quality-checked
